embedding.scope: Exact complete valence singlet embedding and fixed scalar-Schur inertia only; no ground energy certificate or verification of Lieb theorem.

complement.scope: Exact worst weighted Q row for a positive doublon-count profile times positive finite-range charge factors on the neutral open Hubbard chain. The profile vanishes at D=0. Dynamic programming merges prefixes and jointly sums local hopping penalties. Complexity remains exponential in interaction range; no general marginal-cone claim.

scope: Exact interval for the fixed eight-site half-filled open U4 Hubbard chain, using the stated Lieb theorem. Finite sparse research verifier; no universal chemistry or scaling claim.
